security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' asset: http://asset.localhost data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-src 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: A fast, beautiful Markdown IDE that keeps up with your AI agents.
bundle.longDescription: TrailMark reads, navigates and follows Markdown documents as a local wiki over a folder. It renders GitHub-flavored Markdown with math and diagrams, follows files as AI agents (or anyone) change them, and shows what changed since you last looked.
